tickets.title: Coordinate business sale planning handoff
tickets.text: Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with Serena Cloudpuddle's CPA and attorney. Coordinate directly with Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group and Celia Nettlewhisk of Silver Marmot Legal on the sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning for the pending sale of her majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components (estimated gross proceeds about $3.8 million) before any recommendations on staging proceeds.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Liquidity Reserve Snapshot
tickets.text: Size a cash reserve for Serena Cloudpuddle and Adrian Cloudpuddle covering household spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena's mother. Use recurring spending of about $22,000 per month, the $740,000 primary residence mortgage, the $18,000 per month consulting income for twelve months, and about $310,000 held at Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother.

tickets.title: Coordinate estimated tax planning with CPA
tickets.text: Coordinate estimated tax planning with Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group for Serena Cloudpuddle's pending sale of her majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components. The CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available.
tickets.evidence: Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available.

tickets.title: Obtain executed sale and escrow documentation
tickets.text: Obtain the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire instruction evidence for Serena Cloudpuddle's sale of her majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components. Only a summary term sheet was available.
tickets.evidence: Sale documentation remains needed by 2024-07-31 because only a summary term sheet was available, not the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, or wire instruction evidence.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Serena Cloudpuddle's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Evan Thimblefern noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Serena Cloudpuddle and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: Evan noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change; an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23.
